title: Run
description: How and when scans run: schedule, budget, models.

enabled.description: Run scans automatically. Apply with 'scripts/schedule.sh install'.

day_of_month.description: For monthly runs. Max 28 so every month has it.

budget_usd.description: Spending cap for one scan (claude --max-budget-usd). On a subscription this is a notional cost, but the cap still stops the run.

notify.description: Desktop notification when a scheduled scan finishes.

isolate.description: Run scans without your personal Claude Code plugins and MCP servers (cheaper, more predictable).

models.description: Model per agent: sonnet, opus or haiku.
